messages.subject: DEMCO | Power infrastructure, renewable development and stakeholder leadership
messages.body:
Dear DEMCO Leadership Team,

DEMCO's work across electrical engineering, public utilities and renewable project development aligns directly with the energy-transition and stakeholder work I support today.

I currently serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My mandate covers government and regulatory relations, ESG, social performance, corporate coordination and executive stakeholder strategy.

My recent work includes stakeholder and governance support around approximately 46 to 50 MWp of solar capacity and more than 80 MWh of battery storage, together with carbon-data readiness and multi-agency regulatory coordination. I understand the institutional and operating requirements behind large energy and infrastructure programs.

I would welcome consideration for Thailand or regional roles across External Affairs, Sustainability, Government Relations, Strategic Partnerships or country strategy. I have attached a DEMCO-focused executive CV for review.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
